gecko.reasoning_trace: STAGE 1 - FULL-CONTACT BASELINE: The query object has a mass of 1270.0 g and a roughness index of 1620.1. Among retrieved items, the speaker has a similar textured surface finish with roughness 1951.2 and a baseline gecko force of 3.8 N. Anchoring to this baseline yields an initial estimate around 4.5 N. STAGE 2 - WITHIN-SURFACE CONTACT ADJUSTMENT: The query's projected contact fraction is low at 0.2380952381. Using the speaker's controlled variants, a reduction in contact increases the required gecko force (delta of +0.5 N for a 0.476 drop). Adjusting for reduced contact brings the final gecko force estimate to 7.42 N.

Applying the controlled variant adjustments for silicone contact reduction results in an upward adjustment to ensure adequate frictional grip at low contact area, yielding a final estimated normal force of 8.15 N.

comparison_evidence: Gecko dry-adhesive compatibility with clean, dry synthetic leather
recommendation_summary: Both the gecko and silicone grippers are feasible for grasping the clean, dry synthetic leather surface of the query object. However, the gecko gripper is recommended because its dry-adhesive pads achieve higher effective traction on smooth to moderately textured nonporous surfaces at a slightly lower required normal force (7.42 N) compared to the silicone gripper (8.15 N), minimizing potential deformation of the object.
